sections.value: BY THIS POWER OF ATTORNEY MADE this {{date}} ,

{{partyTwo.name}}, a {{partyTwo.occupation}}, of {{partyTwo.address}} (DONEE) to be my true and lawful Attorney and in my name and on my behalf to do all or any of the following acts or things namely:

value:
AND to do all things necessary and incidental to the matters above as I may lawfully do.

AND IT IS DECLARED that this Power of Attorney shall be irrevocable for a period of {{months}} from {{date}} .

IN WITNESS OF WHICH I, the Donor, have executed this Power of Attorney in the manner below on the day and year first above written.

Use this information to enhance the draft.

The draft should be within 500 - 20000 words.

If it is for a consideration use this, 'AND IT IS DECLARED that in consideration of the sum of {{amount}} already paid by the donee to the donor (the receipt of which the donor acknowledges), this power of attorney shall be irrevocable for a period of {{months}} from the {{date}}.'
